title.narrative: Phase IV: Strengthening Resilience through Enhancing Health Service Facilities in Yemen

description.narrative: During 2018 and 2019, UNOPS carried out the physical infrastructure assessment of 101 public and civilian health facilities including district hospitals, dialysis centers, and mother & child hospitals in urban and rural areas in Yemen. Building on the assessments, this project aims at concrete rehabilitation and maintenance works that are related to sanitation, carpentry, electrical, paint and tile (including treatment of cracks and replacement of tiles), and accessibility requirements of the selected health facilities. The proposed plan includes supporting local service providers and local communities in increasing access to primary and secondary health services facilities (general hospitals, local health centers, and therapeutic feeding centers) for the most vulnerable population through restoring the physical infrastructure of health facilities (maintenance works and minor repairs) in target areas. \n
